latestVersion.changelog:
Free Podcast Video 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Instantly convert podcast audio (MP3, WAV, etc.) or video files into ready-to-share 1080p MP4s with captions and visual effects like waveforms.
- Simple, prompt-based workflow: upload your file, describe your goal, and get a shareable video in minutes.
- No need for tokens up front: generates a free, temporary access token automatically for new users.
- Supports intuitive commands for export, credit balance, and status; fully mapped to backend API.
- Automatically manages upload, cloud rendering, and download—all with minimal user setup.
- Error handling and session management ensure smooth, uninterrupted processing.
